draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.63, the 237th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 33rd of 37 at CB. He went 236th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 6 passes defended in 2021, 11th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Chargers. 46 career games and 3 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (2nd percentile), season snap share 3.5% (8th percentile). Played 8 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-4 cornerback who played: 3.5% season snap share against a median of 34.8%, below the norm.
